name: Yanlord Land Group Limited
summary: Yanlord Land Group Limited operates as a real estate developer in China, Singapore, and internationally. It operates through Property Development, Property Investment and Hotel Operations, Property Management, and Others segments. The company develops residential properties, including apartment complexes and villas; and commercial and integrated properties, such as offices, retail shopping centers, serviced apartments, hotels, recreation facilities, and business parks. It also provides property management services for residential and commercial properties under the Yanlord brand; die-casting precision parts; system integration; business management; financial; property facilities management; …
